articles.title: Israel army says it completed ground operation in central Gaza
articles.description: Israel says it completed a rare ground operation in central Gaza despite a ceasefire, amid Hamas denunciations and ongoing clashes.

articles.title: Palestinians flee and Gaza ceasefire tested as Israeli tanks cross ‘yellow line’
articles.description: Israel’s ground operation across the yellow ceasefire line in Gaza, which forced Palestinians to flee their makeshift shelters, marks a fresh escalation in the conflict and risks undermining an already floundering truce with Hamas, analysts said Thursday.

articles.title: Gazans return after Israel army ends rare ground operation
articles.description: Weary Palestinians returned to check their belongings and assess the damage in central Gaza on Thursday, after the Israeli military said it had completed a ground operation it began the day before. The military had launched the incursion involving tanks despite a ceasefire which came into effect in October 2025, saying it aimed to "dismantle a terror tunnel" that posed a threat to troops.

articles.title: Gazans return to battered camp after Israel says it concluded tank raid
articles.description: By Nidal al-Mughrabi and Mahmoud IssaCAIRO/GAZA, Nov 19 (Reuters) - Palestinians started returning to their battered Gaza camp on Thursday after Israel’s military said it had concluded a tank raid to dismantle a suspected Hamas tunnel, its biggest ground incursion across the ceasefire line since last year's truce.Posting a message to the people of Gaza on Facebook, the military said its forces ended an "activity against Hamas infrastructure" in the area, and that the main north-south Salahudeen road had been reopened for traffic.

articles.title: Israel says it concludes tank raid
articles.description: Israel’s military said on Thursday it had concluded a tank raid to dismantle a suspected Hamas tunnel in the central Gaza Strip, its highest-profile ground incursion across the yellow ceasefire line since a truce halted major fighting more than a year ago.

articles.title: IDF Advances Beyond Gaza's Yellow Line - First Major Offensive Since October 2025 Ceasefire
articles.description: Israeli tanks have advanced beyond Gaza's Yellow Line near Nuseirat as the IDF targets a tunnel. Hamas has accused Israel of violating the ceasefire., Middle East, Times Now

articles.title: Israeli ground raid triggers more displacement in central Gaza
articles.description: Israel and Hamas have accused each other of breaching the 2025 ceasefire agreement.

articles.title: Israel launches ground operation in central Gaza as dozens flee
articles.description: The ground advance came as the body overseeing the truce accused Israel and Hamas militants of not meeting their commitments to end hostilities.

articles.title: Dozens flee as Israel launches rare ground operation in central Gaza
articles.description: Dozens of displaced Palestinians flee central Gaza following a rare Israeli ground raid, marking the first such advance since a ceasefire was established in October 2022
